subject: science
domain: Heredity: Inheritance and Variation of Traits

items.prompt:
Can the environment influence an organism's traits?
A) Yes
B) No, never
C) Only parents matter
D) Only on weekends

steps: Conditions like water and light can shape traits.

items.prompt:
A plant with lots of water and sunlight grows tall and green because of
A) its name
B) the environment
C) nothing
D) the color of its pot

steps: Water and sunlight are environmental conditions.

items.prompt:
A dog with lots of exercise has strong muscles. This trait is
A) only inherited
B) influenced by the environment
C) caused by its name
D) random

steps: Exercise and food shaped the muscles.

items.prompt:
Which is an environmental condition that can affect a plant?
A) The amount of water
B) Its parents' names
C) The day of the week
D) Its price

A plant grown in a dark closet grows pale and weak because
A) it got too much light
B) it did not get enough light
C) of its parents only
D) of its pot color
items.answer: B) it did not get enough light

steps: Lack of light, an environmental factor, changed its traits.

items.prompt:
Two plants with the same parents can look different because
A) they grew in different environments
B) traits are never inherited
C) parents do not matter at all
D) plants cannot change
items.answer: A) they grew in different environments

steps: Different conditions can shape their traits.

items.prompt:
A short tree's height might be caused by the environment if it grew
A) in rich soil with lots of light
B) in poor soil with little light
C) with perfect conditions
D) with no parents
items.answer: B) in poor soil with little light

steps: Poor growing conditions can keep a tree short.

items.prompt:
Which statement is correct?
A) All traits come only from parents
B) Some traits are influenced by the environment
C) The environment never affects traits
D) Only animals have traits
items.answer: B) Some traits are influenced by the environment

steps: Traits can be shaped by environmental conditions.
